Swad. Ngifunga ngeKurani enesikhumbuzo.
Empeleni laba abangakholwa bayaziqhayisa futhi bayaphikisa.
Ziningi izizwe esazibhubhisa ngaphambi kwabo; zamemeza, kepha kwakungasiso isikhathi sokubaleka.
Futhi bamangazwe ukuthi kufike kubo umexwayisi ongomunye wabo. Bathi abangakholwa: “Lona ngumlumbi onamanga”.
Uzenza kanjani izikhonzwa kube isikhonzwa esisodwa na?; impela lokhu yinto eyisimanga.
Abayizikhulu kobo baphuma [bathi ebantwini]: “Qhubekani futhi nibambelele kuzikhonzwa zenu; impela lokhu yikona okufunekayo”.
Asikaze sizwe ngalokhu nasenkolweni yokugcina imbala; impela lokhu amanga.
Kwembulela kuye isikhumbuzo sikhona thina?. Empeleni bengabaza isikhumbuzo saMi; empeleni abakasizwa isijeziso saMi.
Kumbe banemicebo yomusa weNkosi yakho enguSomandla Ophanayo.
Kumbe umbuso wamazulu nomhlaba nokumaphakathi kwawo ungowabo; ngakho-ke mabanyuke ngezindlela.
Bayibutho kwamanye amaqembu eliyonqotshwa lapho.
Abantu bakaNuhu nesizwe sakwa Adi noFirawuni wezikhonkwane, baphika ngaphambilini kwabo.
Nesizwe sakwaTamudi nabantu bakaLuti nabantu baseMadiyana. Yiwona-ke lawo amaqembu.
Bonke baphika iZithunywa; base befanelwa isijeziso.
Laba abalinde lutho ngaphandle komsindo owodwa ongabuyeli emuva.
Futhi bathi: “Nkosi yethu shisha usinike imiqulu yethu lungakafiki usuku lokwahlulela”.
Kubekezelele lokho abakushoyo, ukukhumbule isigqila seThu uDawudi owayenamandla; impela wayezikela.
Impela samjubela izintaba zidumisa naye ebusuku nasekuseni.
Nezinyoni ngokunjalo zazibuthaniswa; zonke zazilalela.
Samqinisela ubukhosi bakhe samupha nobuhlakani nobuciko benkulumo.
Ingabe usuzwile ngendaba yabaphikisanyo mhla begibela phezu kwegumbi.

Mhla bengena kuDawudi, wabesaba. Bathi: “Ungesabi, singabaphikisanayo, abanye bethu bahlukumeze abanye, ngakho-ke hlulela phakathi ngeqiniso futhi ungenzi okungebulungiswa futhi usiholele endleleni eqondile”.
Impela umnewethu lona unezimbuzi ezingamashumi ayisishagalolunye nesishagalolunye, mina nginembuzi eyodwa vo, ube esethi: “Nginike yona ngiyinakekele, wangihlula ngenkulomo”.

Wathi: “Impela akenzanga ubulungiswa kuwe ngokucela ukuhlanganisa imbuzi yakho nezimbuzi zakhe; futhi iningi labahlanganisayo bayahlukumezana ngaphandle kwalabo abakholwayo nabenza okulungileyo futhi ave beyidlanzana. uDawudi wacabanga ukuthi besimvivinya, wabe esecela intethelelo eNkosini yakhe waya phansi wakhothama wazilahla.
Samthethelela lokho; futhi impela unendawo eseduze kithi nendawo enhle ayobuyela kuyo.

Wena Dawudi, sikwenze umbusi ezweni, ngakho-ke yehlulela phakathi kwabantu ngeqiniso futhi ungalandeli izinkanuko funa zikuphambukise endleleni ka Allah. Impela laba abaphambuka endleleni ka Allah bayothola isijeziso esinzima ngenxa yokulibala kwabo uSuku lokwahlulela.
Futhi amazulu nomhlaba nokumaphakathi asikudalelanga ize. Lokho umdlinzo walabo abangakholwa; bayobhubha labo angakholwa emlilweni.
Kumbe kumele sense labo abakholwayo nabenza okulungileyo bafane nalabo abenza ukonakala ezweni noma sense abathobela u Allah bafane nezephula mthetho na?
LeNcwadi esiyembulele kuwe ebusisekile, ukuze bahlaziye imibiko yayo futhi labo abakhaliphile bathathe isifundo.
Futhi sapha uDawudi uSulayimani; wabe eyisigqila esihle; impela wayezinikela.
Mhla ekhonjiswa ntambama izinjomane ezime kahle zomjaho.
Wathi: “Impela sengithande kakhulu izinto ezinhle kunokukhumbula iNkosi yami, laze lasithela [ilanga]”.
Wabuyiseni la; waqala wawagenca imilenze nezintamo.
Futhi samvivinya uSulayimani sajikijela isidumbu phezu kwesihlalo sakhe; emuva kwalokho wazithoba.
Wathi: “Nkosi yami ngiphe ubukhosi obungeke butholwe omunye emuva kwami; impela Wena ungoPhayo”.
Samjubela umoya owahamba ngomyalelo wakhe ngesizotha noma kuphi lapho efuna ukuya khona.
Ngokunjalo oShayitani, bonke ababengabakhi nabatshuzi.
Abanye baboshiwe ngamasongo.
Lezi izipho zeThu; iphana omthandayo noma ungaphi omthandayo, ngaphandle kokuba necala.
Futhi impela unendawo eseduze kithi nendawo enhle ayobuyela kuyo.
Futhi khumbula isigqila seThu u Ayubu mhla ekhuleka eNkosini yakhe [ethi]: “Impela uShayitani ungihlasele ngokukhathala nobunzima”.
Shaya phansi ngomlenze wakho; lawa ngamanzi okugeza abandayo nokuphuza.
Samupha umndeni wakhe usuphindwe kabili, kuwumusa ovela kithi nesikhumbuzo kulabo abakhaliphile.
Futhi thatha ngesandla sakho inyanda yezinswazi ukuze ungaphuli isibophezelo sakho. Impela samfumanisa enokubekezela; uyigqila esihle, impela uyazithoba.
Futhi khumbula izigqila zeThu u Ibhirahimu no Isihaki no Yakubu ababenamandla nolwazi olunzulu.
Impela sabaqoka ngesimilo sekhethelo: ukukhumbula elizayo.
Futhi kithi bangaqokiwe bekhethelo.
Futhi khumbula u Isima-ili no Aliyasa no Dulikifili; bonke bangabekhethelo.
Lesi isikhumbuzo; futhi impela labo abathobela u Allah bayothola indawo enhle abayobuyela kuyo.
Izivande zaphakade, bayovulelwa iminyango.
Bayohlala baqhiyame kuzo, bafune kuzo izithelo eziningi neziphuzo.
Futhi bayoba namatshitshi akhophozelayo angontanga.
Yikho-ke lokhu enithenjiswe kona ngoSuku lokwahlulela.
Impela lesi isondlo seThu asisoze saphela.
Lokhu [kunjalo]. Kepha amahlongandlebe ayothola indawo embi ayobuyela kuyo.
iJahananmu abayongena kuyo; okuyindawo embi.
Lesi [isijeziso], amanzi abilayo nobomvu, mabasizwe.
Kunesinye esifana nalesi, esinehlobo eziningi.
[Bayothi]: “Nalu uquqaba eniyongena nalo; alwamukelekile, impela luyongena emlilweni”.
Bayothi: “Empeleni yinina eningamukelekile; yinina enisilethele sona [isijeziso], yaze yayimbi indawo”.
Bayothi: “Nkosi yethu, lowo osilethele lokhu, mandisele ngesijeziso esiphindaphindiwe emlilweni”.
Futhi bayothi: “Kungani singawaboni amadoda esiwala kanye nabantu ababi na?”
Ingabe sibenze inhlekisa kumbe amehlo ethu angababoni.
Impela lokho kuphikisana kwabantu abasemlilweni kuyiqiniso.
Yithi: “Mina ngingumexwayisi nje kuphela; futhi akekho okufanele akhonzwe ngaphandle kuka Allah Oyedwa Ongumlawuli”.
iNkosi yamazulu nomhlaba nokumaphakathi kwawo enguSomandla enguMthetheleli.
Yithi: “Iwudaba olunzima”.
Kepha nina nilushaya indiva.
Bengingenalo ulwazi mayelana nezingelosi mhla ziphikisana.
Kuphela kwembulelwa kimi ukuthi ngingumexwayisi ocacisayo.
Landisa ngamhla iNkosi yakho yithi ezingelosini: “Impela ngizodala umuntu ngobumba”.
Uma sengimbumbile ngaphefumulela kuye ngomphefumulo wami; mkhothameleni niwe phansi ngobuso.
Zonke izingelosi ngothi lwazo sawa phansi ngobuso zakhothama.
Ngaphandle kuka Ibilisi, waziqhayisa waba ngomunye wabangakholwa.
Wathi: “We Ibilisi, uvinjwe yini ukuwa phansi ngobuso ukhothamele lokhu engikudale ngeZandla zaMi zombili na?”
Wathi: “Mina ngingcono kunaye; mina ungidale ngomlilo yena wamdala ngobumba”.
Wathi: “Phuma kuyo [iJana] ngokuba wena usuxoshiwe”.
Futhi impela wehlelwe isiqalekiso saMi kuyoze kube uSuku lokwahlulela.
Wathi: “Ngiphe impilo ende kuze kube uSuku lokuVuswa”.
Wathi: “Nakanjani ungomunye walaba abanikwe impilo ende”.
Kuze kube isikhathi esaziwayo.
Wathi: “Ngifunga ngobukhulu bakho, impela ngizodukisa bonke”.
Ngaphandle kwezigqila zaKho ezikhethekile.
Wathi: “Iqiniso futhi iqiniso engolishoyo”
Ngizogcwalisa iJahanamu ngawe nangalabo kubo abazokulandela ngothi lwabo.
Yithi: “Anginiceli ngakho umvuzo futhi mina azihluphi ngokuqamba amanga”.
Iyisikhumbuzo [iKurani] nje kuphela kundalo yonke.
Futhi nizolwazi udaba lwayo emuva kwesikhashana.
